output.brief: Store 14's shrink rise may be real or may be an artifact of estimation. The interim figures are extrapolated from partial cycle counts with a margin of about ±0.6 points per quarter. Across the chain, about half of two-quarter interim rises of this size were not confirmed by the year-end count. Store 14's own full-count history is steady at 1.5–1.8%. The shoplifting log increase coincides with the chain-wide launch of the incident app on 1 April. Chain-wide, recorded incidents rose while shrink stayed flat. So that log is weak evidence of more theft. The ethics-line tip was checked on CCTV and showed bale runs to the compactor, so it gives no basis for acting against the stocker. Nothing yet separates self-checkout, footfall or staff theft as the cause. I'm moderately confident in this. Next steps: keep store 14 in the 7 December full count and decline the proposal to skip it. That count is the only reliable measure. Hold off on pulling or staffing the lanes, hiring a guard, or disciplining anyone until the count result is compared with the interim figures. Then target the response at whatever the count shows, including departmental and SKU detail.
